message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine charges based on facts. The primary charge likely is something like "妨害公务" (obstructing official duties) or "故意伤害" (intentional injury) or "聚众斗殴"? Let's see.

Facts: Administrative law enforcement officers cleaning road, villagers obstruct. The officer tried to forcefully remove villagers. Shen Mou Jia (defendant) punched officer Zhang Mou Jia in the head to stop removal of his uncle Shen Mou Yi. So he assaulted a law enforcement officer performing official duties. This is likely "妨害公务" (obstructing official duties) or "暴力抗拒执行公务" (resisting law enforcement with violence). In Chinese criminal law, article 277: "妨害公务罪" includes using violence, threats, or other means to obstruct public officials performing duties. Also "故意伤害罪" if injury caused. The fact says he punched head, but no mention of injury severity. Could be "故意伤害" if injury. But the primary charge likely "妨害公务". The companion charges list includes "妨害作证" (obstructing testimony) but not relevant. So only primary.

Thus answer: [罪名]妨害公务<eoa>

Check if any other charges: He used violence against law enforcement, could be "非法拘禁"? No. "聚众斗殴"? No. So just one.
